title: Needs bug fixes
body: Good ideas but poorly developed: 1) I set a reminder for a daily goal on a specific hour but it sends me 3 reminders on different times of day; 2) it asks me to log progress though it is already logged; 3) I set a monthly goal with a rule to log it on a specific day but it asks me to log it everyday; 4) the monthly goal progress screen shows current weekdays which is not logic as I need to log the goal achievement only 1 time per month .. And so on
